name: Rooted and Ordinary False Positives for Original-Cube Pruning
definition: Normalize the certified $292$-concept rooted factor to root zero, calling it $B$, and form the $583$-concept one-point double $X$ of two copies of $B$ on disjoint twelve-coordinate blocks.
parameters: $B$ has order $292$, dimension $12$, and VC dimension $4$; $X$ has order $583$, dimension $24$, and VC dimension $4$. The certified pruning sequences have lengths $291$ and $583$.
properties: Original-cube pruning leaves only the protected root in $B$ and leaves the empty set in $X$, although $B$ cannot peel to its root and $X$ cannot peel at all. After the first pruning deletion $32$, vertex $64$ is permitted by its original complete four-cube even though that cube has just lost vertex $32$. Complete negative deletion graphs have eight rooted states and sixty-four ordinary states.
